notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Image Labo.

We have updated Recolit today.
It fixes the direction of the hard-to-understand part of the story at the end of the game, and also fixes some small bugs.

- Added dialogues at the end of Stage 3
- Fixed the direction from the end of Stage 3 to the beginning of Stage 4 ([spoiler]before opening the orange door[/spoiler]) and the end of Stage 4

- Fixed an issue where [spoiler]stamps on cards were sometimes not displayed[/spoiler] in Stage 3.
- Fixed difficulty in [spoiler]solving the drink riddle[/spoiler] in Stage 4

[hr][/hr]

If you only want to see the fixed direction, we recommend that you start from the following chapters.

- Last chapter of Stage 3
- Last chapter of Stage 4

notes.title: - Release Date Announcement: February 16th, 2024 -
notes.notes:
Hello. This is Image Labo, the developer behind Recolit.
Recolit's release date has been set to February 16th, 2024, at 6:00 PM (Japan time).
(Pacific Time: 1:00 AM - Eastern Time: 4:00 AM - GMT: 9:00 AM)

Thank you for your patience and for supporting us for so long!

We also have some detailed information on the game and two new announcements.

[h2]Release Details[/h2]

Play time: About 2 to 4 hours
Retail price: $14.99
Supported OS: Windows (we're considering Mac)
Languages: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese (plus French and Russian)

[h2]We are including two new languages[/h2]

In addition to the four languages we had already announced, we will be supporting two new ones:

French (Translated by Malaurie Prévost)
Russian (Translated by nonotion)

Please note that support for these two languages may be added through an update after the release.

[h2]Ending Theme Creator Announcement[/h2]

The ending theme of Recolit has been created by composer DenkiQujira. It achieves the same vibe as the main soundtrack through an entirely different perspective, so please look forward to hearing both of them.

Good holidays.
(If you need me, I'll be eating the traditional Japanese New Year's buckwheat noodles.)
